name: 希帕基娅

identity.findings: 马罗涅亚犬儒哲学家，克拉特斯伴侣、梅特罗克勒斯之妹；约前340—前330年生为现代推估，卒年不详。苏达记载其哲学论辩，拉尔修相邻段落所载书信及悲剧属克拉特斯。

sources.title: Diogenes Laertius：Lives of the Eminent Philosophers, Book VI（Hicks英译，维基文库录本）
sources.readScope: 本回合读入卷六文本：目录（第7节列Hipparchia）、Crates段93（Alexander/Philip一句、Eratosthenes记Pasicles生）、Metrocles段94、Hipparchia段96—98全文。未通读其余各节。

sources.title: IEP：Hipparchia of Maroneia
sources.readScope: 通读专条（阅读经结构化提取完成，覆盖导言至结论）：生年340—330推定、马里oneia、兄长Metrocles（原Lyceum学生）、爱上克拉特斯言谈与生活、脱衣相示引文、犬儒婚姻与Epictetus独身例外、anaideia、Theodorus交锋（酒神伴侣引文/教育反问/打人三段论/扒斗篷）、Cynic Epistles的athlete生产与龟壳摇篮细节、DL晚出与apt stories警示、著作尽佚、对芝诺《理想国》男女平等的影响。

sources.title: Suda On Line：Hipparchia，iota 517
sources.readScope: 实读iota 517条的英译与编辑注：马罗涅亚、兄长与伴侣、哲学论题和对塞奥多罗斯的驳论，及第111届奥林匹亚纪年；该条未保存作品正文。

sources.title: Suda On Line：关于《苏达辞书》
sources.readScope: 实读项目说明中辞书约于公元10世纪编纂及作者不详的信息。

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 马里oneia出身、活跃于前300年前后、兄长原为Theophrastus学生、爱上克拉特斯言谈与生活、以死允婚、脱衣相示语。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: §96：Hipparchia too, sister of Metrocles…captured by their doctrines. Both of them were born at Maroneia…fell in love with the discourses and the life of Crates…This is the bridegroom, here are his possessions；§94：Metrocles…pupil of Theophrastus the Peripatetic；生年推定见iep-hipparchia

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 同装、公开生活、同赴宴饮；阿普利乌斯/奥古斯丁晚出转述；安提斯泰尼—第欧根尼不婚传统与爱比克泰德例外。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: Cynic marriage节：later authors (Apuleius, Augustine)…infamous；earlier Cynics like Diogenes and Antisthenes held the philosopher would never marry；Epictetus later allowed exceptions…because of this marriage；§97：adopting the same dress…lived with him in public and went out to dinners（dl6-hicks）

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 吕西马库斯宴席：酒神伴侣之讥、教育反问、打人三段论、扒斗篷、不动声色。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: §97—98：Any action which would not be called wrong if done by Theodorus…；He had no reply…but tried to strip her of her cloak…no sign of alarm；Is this she Who quitting woof and warp and comb and loom?；instead of wasting further time upon the loom I spent it in education

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 著作尽佚（书信、玩笑、驳论）；史料晚出传说混杂；经克拉特斯影响芝诺《理想国》男女平等。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: sources节：DL is writing centuries later…may include 'apt' stories；No writings of Hipparchia survive (DL says she wrote letters, jokes, refutations, now lost)；influenced Zeno…whose Republic advocated sexual equality；另一手佐证dl6-hicks §98

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 生年推定、马里oneia、兄长师承、求婚叙事。
previousChecksBefore20261028.locator: §96全文；§94；生年推定见iep-hipparchia（born between 340–330 B.C.E., mid-teens）

previousChecksBefore20261028.claim: 犬儒婚姻与按犬儒方式养育子女；Pasicles；书信集价值有争议。

sourceDiscrepancy: IEP专条将书信、玩笑与驳论归为拉尔修对希帕基娅的记载；直接核读VI.98 Hicks英译，紧接希帕基娅轶事的是明确署名Crates的Epistles和悲剧。另据苏达iota 517，希帕基娅有哲学论题及对塞奥多罗斯的驳论记载，未见现存正文。
